warnings: Log elemental zinc, not the weight of the zinc salt.
Total zinc from food and supplements above 40 mg/day over weeks can cause copper deficiency.
Phytate in cereal-pulse diets lowers absorption; intake in the ring is not the same as absorbed zinc.
Space zinc from quinolone or tetracycline antibiotics and penicillamine; ask a pharmacist for the gap.
Iron supplements of 25 mg or more taken together can lower zinc absorption.
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney or liver disease, and children's diarrhoea courses: follow the doctor's or health worker's advice; the app does not set a higher target.
